# ScrapCentre

> ScrapCentre is a government-authorised Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facility (RVSF) in India, based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. It offers free vehicle valuation, free doorstep pickup, RC cancellation support and an official Certificate of Deposit (CoD) issued through the Parivahan system, for cars, two-wheelers, trucks, buses and autos. The site is available in English and Hindi.

Key facts
- Business: ScrapCentre (also written ScrapCenter India), an automotive business and RVSF; the site describes it as India's largest capacity RVSF.
- Address: 26-A & B, Block-E, Panki, Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208020, India.
- Phone: +91-9839447733. Email: contact@scrapcentre.com.
- Cities with a live ScrapCentre service page: Kanpur, Agra, Lucknow, Kannauj, Etawah.
- What you get: free valuation, free doorstep pickup, Certificate of Deposit (CoD), RC cancellation assistance.
- Hindi pages live under /hi/ (for example https://www.scrapcentre.com/hi).

- [Certificate of Deposit for Vehicle Scrapping: How the Road-Tax Rebate Works](https://www.scrapcentre.com/blog/certificate-of-deposit-for-vehicle-scrapping): What a CoD is, who issues it, and how it can help with a road-tax concession when registering a new vehicle.
- [Blog](https://www.scrapcentre.com/blog): All ScrapCentre guides on vehicle scrapping and RVSF rules.
